mathematical_result.statement: For Q=U^T H U+2U^T g(T)+r(T), U independent of T, arbitrary measurable environment-dependent recentering U->U+psi(T) leaves the anchor Hessian H exactly invariant. Therefore any affine-uniform conditional interval-density estimate transfers with the identical constant through arbitrary shifts, fragments and unbounded supports, while translations cannot improve anchor curvature. On the exact-target diffuse family A_m=U_0 B_* U_0^T, the best physical triple scale is 1/m before and after every such recentering.
